Game of Codes

Game of Codes is a flagship competitive programming contest organized by the Developers & Coders Club (DCC), NIT Agartala, as part of AAYAM XI — the annual techno-management fest of National Institute of Technology Agartala.

The contest aims to bring together passionate programmers and problem solvers to challenge their algorithmic thinking, strengthen their coding skills, and compete against some of the brightest minds through an exciting battle of logic, speed, and precision.

Competition Format & Rounds

The competition will be conducted in two rounds:

Round 1 — Online Coding Contest

  • Date: 13 November 2026
  • Time: 08:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
  • Mode: Online
  • Participants will solve algorithmic and data structure-based programming problems within the given time limit.
  • Problems will vary in difficulty, testing logical reasoning, problem-solving ability, and coding efficiency.
  • Participants will be evaluated based on problem-solving performance, accuracy, and efficiency.

Round 2 — Offline Coding Contest

  • Date: 15 November 2026
  • Time: 10:00 AM – 01:00 PM IST
  • Venue: NIT Agartala
  • Top-performing participants from Round 1 will qualify for the offline final round.
  • Shortlisted participants will compete in an intensive coding challenge featuring problems designed to test their algorithmic expertise, implementation skills, and ability to perform under pressure.

Whatsapp Group:

https://chat.whatsapp.com/LEdJR5igC3mEfv1YAeEngO?s=cl&p=a&iam=2

Eligibility & Participation

  • Open to all students and coding enthusiasts.
  • Individual participation.
  • Participants must have a basic understanding of programming and data structures.
  • No prior competitive programming experience is mandatory.

Evaluation Criteria

  • Correctness of solutions
  • Problem-solving efficiency
  • Algorithmic approach and optimization
  • Number of problems solved
  • Time and penalty considerations

Why Game of Codes?

  • Think fast.
  • Code smart.
  • Debug faster.
  • Every problem is a challenge. Every submission is a battle against time.

This isn't just about writing code, it's about mastering the art of problem-solving.

Step up. Compete. Conquer the Code.

Organized by:
Developers & Coders Club (DCC)
National Institute of Technology Agartala
As part of AAYAM XI
